Warm yellow against cyan; pleasant; cyan saturated.
Prop rotates without blur; scene otherwise static; flicker mean 1.91 / max 2.23.
Aircraft motionless above the water at throttle 0%; no bobbing, drift or immersion.
Cars on the causeway, two ships, a boat, a channel marker; no people or birds.
entries.fix: Add people on the causeway shore.

entries.evidence: Airframe detail high; background ships slabs.
Lamp posts and piers evenly spaced; cars repeated.
1-px prop rods with box tips, stay moiré, blurred water texture.
HUD legible; debug string.
renderMs 11.7, clip frame 0 at 5207 ms (warmup hitch), steady mean 12.4 ms, max 38.8 ms, std 5.5; 1.05 M triangles, 303 calls.

entries.condition: still_grid fixed close camera on the port side at 15:30, aircraft idling on the harbour
entries.evidence: Wing fills rows 1-2 as a yellow bar across the full width, windscreen and cabin sit at B3-F4 left of centre, horizon at y=0.27 visible only at A3-B3 and F3-H3, and the float-strut lattice crosses the right half from F2 to H8 in front of the tail and skyline.
entries.defect: Strut lattice and wing bar clutter two thirds of the frame and the struts cut through the stabilizer and skyline at G3-H4.
entries.fix: Move the camera 1 m forward and 0.5 m down so the windscreen stays central and the rear strut set falls outside the frame.

entries.condition: still_grid port-side silhouette at close range
entries.evidence: Deep Beaver-style fuselage with sloped nose, high-wing with struts, cabin door outline and twin floats on a strut lattice; the cabin roof and windscreen frame are inflated rounded tubes rather than sheet-metal edges.
entries.defect: Windscreen pillars and roof read as thick rounded pipes about 3x the real frame thickness.
entries.fix: Thin the windscreen frame members and sharpen the roof-to-frame crease.

entries.evidence: Rivet rows, panel seams, door outline, boarding step, antenna mast and a cylindrical strut lattice with cleats are modelled; the horizontal stabilizer at H4 is a 2-px plank and the fin at G3 is a flat beige slab with a black rectangular rudder slot.
entries.defect: Plank-thin stabilizer and fin plates behind a fully modelled fuselage (hard failure: paper-thin geometry).
entries.fix: Give the tail surfaces an airfoil section and model the rudder hinge instead of a black slot.

entries.condition: pilot head and door vs fuselage, channel marker at H3
entries.evidence: Pilot head about 0.3 of cabin height, door about 1.1 m tall against a 1.6 m deep fuselage, strut tubes about 5 cm; the channel marker at H3 subtends a plausible 1.2 m at 300 m.
entries.defect: Windscreen frame members are oversized relative to the rivet pitch.
entries.fix: Scale frame tubes down by half.

entries.condition: z_paint_rivets, z_cheatline and colour samples under a 15:30 sun
entries.evidence: White top (199,198,197) is uniform across the whole roof with no specular lobe, shaded yellow (128,101,24) has one smooth gradient, black cowl at A5-A7 matches the same matte response; rivets are the only surface variation and the cheatline plus 'BAHIA VISTA AIR TAXI' text at E5 are mip-blurred.
entries.defect: One matte roughness across the entire airframe in direct sun (hard failure: uniform roughness across a whole object).
entries.fix: Add a clear-coat layer with roughness 0.2-0.3, a panel-line roughness map and a 2x higher-resolution livery texture.

entries.condition: z_windscreen, z_side_windows and gs_glass montage over f000-f059
entries.evidence: Windscreen shows the water behind at (100,134,155) against (83,110,134) outside with no sky or sun reflection; side windows carry a faint grey tint only; the interior is untextured blue seat boxes, orange panels, two blue cylinders for a yoke and a sphere head; no Fresnel response at any angle across the clip.
entries.defect: Glass with zero reflection under a direct 15:30 sun in the view built to test it (hard failure: wrong reflections on glass).
entries.fix: Add a Fresnel-weighted environment and sun reflection to the glass shader and replace the interior blocks with a textured panel, seats and pilot.

entries.evidence: Skyline of pastel boxes with two blue glass towers, a container ship with coloured containers, a cruise-ship slab, a causeway with cars and lamps; towers have flat roofs and no crowns.
entries.defect: Towers are extruded boxes and the ships are slabs with one superstructure block.
entries.fix: Add roof massing and ship superstructure detail.

entries.evidence: Mainland shore is a straight sand line under the skyline with blob trees; a small island at right has a flat sand rim.
entries.defect: Straight shore and uniform sand rim.
entries.fix: Displace the coastline with noise and add a wet-sand band.

entries.evidence: Far (73,102,126), mid (52,108,142), near (59,91,116): a deep harbour blue that reads believable, but the surface is soft horizontal normal-map smears with no wavelets at 3-10 m from the camera.
entries.defect: Close-range water has no small-scale wave detail.
entries.fix: Add a high-frequency ripple normal layer for the first 20 m.

entries.evidence: A yellow fuselage and grey floats 1 m above calm water produce no reflection; skyline, ship and struts likewise unreflected.
entries.defect: Missing reflection of the aircraft on the water it sits on (hard failure: wrong reflections).
entries.fix: Add a planar reflection pass for fixed cameras blended by Fresnel.

entries.condition: z_float_keels at 2x and gs_floats montage f000-f059
entries.evidence: Both float keels sit above a straight-edged white band that trails aft; no displacement wave, no immersion, and no heave or roll across 60 frames while the aircraft drifts at 5-10 kt.
entries.defect: Floats hover above straight white wake bands (hard failure: floating geometry).
entries.fix: Lower the resting waterline so the keel is immersed, add bow waves and a buoyancy solver with wave response.

entries.evidence: Blob crowns in two greens along the far shore and on the small island; no palms visible.
entries.fix: Add palm and broadleaf species with impostors.

entries.evidence: Causeway viaduct with piers reaching the water, lamp posts and cars; cable-stayed bridge stays visible above it at A2; channel marker at H3 and a moving boat under the causeway.
entries.defect: Stays render as fine dotted lines.

entries.evidence: Flat-bottomed lens puffs with uniform brightness above the wing; the single cumulus puff at C1 has a straight base.
entries.fix: Add cumulus towers with tapered bases and shaded undersides.

entries.evidence: Skyline and ships desaturate toward pastel, the horizon sky warms to (119,111,92) and the far island is hazed; the causeway keeps slightly too much contrast for its distance.
White roof (199,198,197) below clipping, shaded yellow side legible, strut tops carry a highlight while undersides go dark; the cabin roof under the wing is as bright as the exposed roof.
entries.defect: Wing casts no shade on the roof and the lighting reads non-directional on the fuselage.
entries.fix: Enable self-shadowing and check the sun vector against the 15:30 clock.

entries.evidence: Dark aircraft shadow on the water under the floats (48,50,50); struts cast no shadows on the floats, the wing casts none on the cabin roof and the fuselage none on the floats.
entries.defect: Self-shadowing absent on the whole aircraft.
entries.fix: Include the airframe in the shadow pass with a contact-hardening bias.

entries.evidence: No specular lobe on paint, no glass reflection, no sun glitter on water; only the strut tubes carry a metallic highlight.
entries.defect: Specular response missing on paint, glass and water in direct sun.
entries.fix: GGX clear-coat, glass Fresnel and a sun glitter term.

entries.evidence: Warm yellow airframe against blue-grey harbour water and a warm haze band; coherent afternoon grade.

entries.condition: gs_glass and gs_floats montages plus flicker metrics
entries.evidence: Aircraft drifts smoothly across the fixed camera over 60 frames; flicker mean 2.88 / max 4.53; dotted stays at A2 and causeway railings change pattern frame to frame.
entries.defect: Thin-line shimmer on stays and railings.

entries.evidence: HUD shows 10 KIAS, 6 ft, RPM 600 and 0% throttle while telemetry reports 5 kt on the water at 2 ft; the aircraft translates at constant speed with no heave, pitch or roll and no propwash.
entries.defect: Aircraft slides across the water as a rigid body with contradictory HUD and telemetry.
entries.fix: Drive HUD and buoyancy from one water-contact state and add wave-driven motion.

entries.evidence: Causeway traffic, a container ship, a boat, a channel marker and a skyline; no dock, buoys, birds or other seaplanes near the idling aircraft.
entries.defect: Immediate surroundings empty for a harbour.
entries.fix: Add a seaplane dock, mooring buoys and gulls.

entries.evidence: Rivets and seams are resolved to 1 cm on the skin while the interior 30 cm behind the glass is untextured boxes; skyline and ships are slabs.
entries.defect: Interior fidelity collapses within 1 m of the highest-detail surface.
entries.fix: Model the panel, seats and pilot at the same density as the exterior.

entries.evidence: Identical strut tubes and cleats repeated, lamps evenly spaced on the causeway, skyline boxes share two window textures.
entries.fix: Jitter lamp spacing and vary facade textures.

entries.evidence: Mip-blurred livery text and registration, dotted cable stays, straight-edged white wake bands under the floats, blurry water normals.
entries.defect: Texture blur and thin-line aliasing at arm's length.
entries.fix: Higher-resolution livery textures, thicker stays, soft wake decals.

entries.evidence: HUD legible; the A2 and H2 panels overlap the yellow wing leading edge; debug seed string at A8.
entries.defect: HUD panels overlap the subject and a debug string is visible.
entries.fix: Shrink HUD margins and hide the debug string.

entries.defect: 2.9 s first-frame hitch on a fixed camera.
